appearances.snippet: Born in California in 1919, the article tells us David Berg had a very turbulent life, one that included incestuous sexual relations with a cousin and even one of his daughters, Faithy, whom he made into a sexual partner when she reached the age of 12.

verification.notes: Academic and first-person sources support allegations that Berg sexually abused daughters, including Faithy in childhood, and promoted incest. The exact compound details that he also had sex with a cousin and made Faithy a sexual partner specifically at age twelve were not all independently established by the strongest sources reviewed.
